calls.reason: An undated, hedged belief with no deadline. SoftBank's October 2026 disclosure that it completed its $30B investment weighs against an imminent collapse but cannot settle 'someday'.
Huang's 'never a commitment' remarks came around Feb 1, before the target week. Reuters has him saying on Feb 3 that the plans were on track, so the evidence on a pullback in that week is mixed.

Leaked statements show a 2025 operating loss of about $21B. WSJ and Fortune reporting put OpenAI's own profitability projections around 2029–2030, years out, though quarterly figures were not located.

Two weeks later Nvidia and SoftBank each committed $30B and Amazon $50B. The round closed upsized at $122B with new individual investors. Weak secondary demand was tied to Anthropic and valuation, not Nvidia or SoftBank.
A Feb 10 Reuters report says investors had grown concerned about OpenAI's ability to finance its commitments. MoneyWeek in December 2025 also described growing concerns.
The condition never happened: SoftBank completed its $30B investment in October 2026 and no funding cutoff is documented, so the predicted consequences cannot be tested.
